title: Static Low Boat Body S-Neck Arched-Wing Swan
description: One newly authored complete stylised swan-like bird in a fixed grounded pose. A broad low boat-shaped torso narrows continuously through its rising front breast into a long pronounced S-curved neck and a small forward head, all one closed skin. Two complete raised arched folded-wing lobes frame the back and taper rearward; a short flattened full bill and small lateral eyes finish the head. Two short bent legs connect to broad flat webbed feet below the low body. Every body/neck/wing/foot coordinate newly authored, no old bird mesh or section array imported. Unlike the high long-legged wading bird with separated toes and narrow spear bill, this whole bird has a low broad body, short support legs, webs and raised folded wing silhouettes. Unlike the compact short-neck duck-like bird, its neck rises far above the low torso through a clear continuous S profile rather than merely enlarging its head. One static animal model zero scenes. No exact species, feather microanatomy, flight, swimming, gait, buoyancy, ecology or biological function claim; rig animation and interaction not made.
